us: Posture unchanged one day past MOU expiry
effects: Trump claims strait 'open and operating' · Transit data says otherwise · Tally 64 redirected / 3 disabled / 2 boarded
tldr: Trump said the strait was 'open and operating' — unsupported by transit data — as the June ceasefire memorandum effectively expired with no announced change in force posture, rules of engagement or target sets.

dossier: Also in the window: the bulk carrier Minoan Dignity was struck roughly half a nautical mile off the Omani coast overnight into August 18, its chief engineer killed (UKMTO alert 01:35 UTC; wider coverage surfaced August 19–20); Windward identified the tanker seized near Qeshm on the 17th as the Amara. Rubio phoned Emirati NSA Sheikh Tahnoon after the missile detections, which Tehran denied. AP framed the trade suspension as effective Wednesday, August 19; Gulf News carried the announcement late August 18.
